description.p: A COSMIC Desktop application for opening a package file you have downloaded, seeing exactly what is in it, and installing it.

ul.li: the application icon and name taken from the package itself
the version, and whether that version is already installed
the full metadata, and the list of files the package installs
every declared dependency, marked according to whether it is already installed, available from your package manager, or missing
what installing would really do — including packages pulled in indirectly — with download and disk-space figures

description.p: Install, upgrade, downgrade, reinstall and uninstall are all offered as appropriate for what is already on the system. Privileged operations go through PackageKit where it is available, and fall back to the distribution's own tools under polkit where it is not; the application itself never runs as root.
Debian packages are fully supported. RPM, Flatpak and AppImage support is in progress — the application reports honestly which formats the system it is running on can handle.
First release. Debian package support: inspection, dependency status, resolved install plan, and install, upgrade, downgrade, reinstall and uninstall via PackageKit or apt.
